status: Partial executable ability composed from generic motion, target-owned tracking gates, observation, current-slot energy and cyclic recharge; explicit calibration and production gaps remain

known.melee_return_basis: fixed; no recipient chunk or additional stat scalar

primary_sources.finding: 100 Melee with a nearby enemy restores two charges for multi-charge abilities; 50 Melee near an enemy restores one.

primary_sources.excerpt: In PvP only, reduced melee energy gain from 50% to 35%.

engine_requirement: One instantaneous energy packet can complete multiple cycles, preserving the next partial meter and discarding only the remainder after usable capacity fills. Pure core must not cap every incoming packet to one progress bar.
unresolved: Actual dodge displacement, animation duration and energy-return frame require calibration.
Proximity origin/anchor, visibility, sampling time, mixed-mode enemy eligibility and selection changes during the dodge require original-game verification.

Chorus tracking removal is partially composed; vanilla homing projectiles, AI and Guardian aim assist, enhanced Class-stat shield, full Class passive/chunk curves, Aspect conversions, equipment combinations and production assembly remain incomplete.

implementation.consumer: Lightweight Knife explicitly opts into solar_melee_cycle_yield for current-slot packets

policies.activation: Native on_ground gate; one class charge is paid before horizontal collision-resolved displacement.
policies.sampling: After the explicitly calibrated return delay: living caster, current Melee stat capped at 100, current mode, current melee selection, and current enemy membership.
policies.proximity: Inclusive body-to-body 15-meter sphere; current not_allied relation, excludes self, no line-of-sight requirement, nearest one eligible target is sufficient.
policies.movement_result: Applied and unchanged collision-resolved movement schedule the return; known rejection does not. Unknown world observations retain payment and motion without replay.
policies.lifecycle: Paid detached return survives class deselection; dead/missing caster or unavailable target query skips return. Runtime closure discards pending work.
policies.recharge: 56-second baseline is supplied only by the selected ability source; the full gamblers_dodge_regeneration and class_gain profiles must be linked externally. Test profiles do not supply a measured Class-stat curve.
policies.ophidia: Accepted real dodge refreshes existing Scissor Fingers without creating stacks; the current Solar cycle-yield policy applies when the packet completes cycles.
policies.class_account: This ability currently owns one independent class account; switching to other class abilities does not migrate balances or implement original-game swap penalties.
policies.tracking: See gamblers-dodge-tracking.json: required independent animation_duration; target-owned Combatant tracking gate, physical damage unchanged, original owner kind captured at launch.

synthetic_inputs.class_stat_scaling: neutral fixture, not a measured Class curve
